tasks.implemented_behavior: Printed map length/area scale, signed DMS coordinates, spherical distance and grid bearings.
tasks.bounded_contract:
`scale_distance`: `map_length {value,unit}` and positive `scale_denominator`; length units mm/cm/m/km. Ground metres = map metres times scale.
`scale_area`: map_area (mm2/cm2/m2); ground area = map area times scale squared.
`dms`: axis latitude/longitude; integer degrees/minutes, exact seconds; corresponding N/S or E/W hemisphere; limits 90/180, minutes/seconds <60. Negative degree entry is not combined with a hemisphere.
`spherical_distance`: two numeric degree coordinate objects and positive caller-supplied sphere radius. Haversine shortest spherical arc, antimeridian-safe; outputs floats with declared comparison tolerances.
`planar_bearing`: signed east/north displacement; clockwise angle from grid north, atan2(east,north); zero vector rejected.
tasks.bounds_and_open_scope: No actual map, raster, projection, image/OCR, ellipsoidal geodesic, changing scale or routing interpretation. Printed-scale and supplied-sphere assumptions must be true upstream.

tasks.implemented_behavior: Declared global energy/water budgets, 30-year anomaly arithmetic, area weighting and feedback polarity.
tasks.bounded_contract:
`planetary_budget`: S>0, albedo in [0,1], emissivity in (0,1]; absorbed = S(1-a)/4, reflected = Sa/4; radiating temperature from absorbed/(emissivity*sigma) to power 1/4. Sigma is 5.670374419e-8 in declared SI units.
`water_budget`: precipitation minus evapotranspiration minus runoff in mm, allowing signed storage change; mm/cm/m inputs.
`temperature_anomaly`: exactly 30 distinct consecutive supplied annual means matching baseline_start..end, years 1..9999. Equal-year mean only. Absolute input temperature units degC/K; converted before anomaly. Below absolute zero rejected.
`area_weighted_temperature`: unique declared nonoverlapping regions and strictly positive km2 weights.
`feedback_loop`: 2..32 signed edges forming exactly one simple closed cycle; sign product positive means reinforcing, negative means balancing.
tasks.bounds_and_open_scope: Effective radiating temperature is not observed surface temperature. No climate forecast, empirical feedback attribution, station homogenization, missing-year imputation or certified climate-normal computation.

tasks.implemented_behavior: Exact table arithmetic and structured cell-to-chart fidelity with explicit missing data and axes.
tasks.bounded_contract:
`summary`: unique row IDs, rational values or null, missing_policy reject/exclude_explicit; sum, mean, odd/even median, observed/missing counts and excluded IDs; all missing rejected.
`percent_change`: positive baseline, nonnegative final value; 100(after-before)/before.
`weighted_mean`: unique rows with nonnegative weight and signed rational values; total weight strictly positive.
`chart_fidelity`: source_rows vs chart_points joined by ID; explicit source/chart units, bar/line/scatter type and bounded linear/log y_axis. Mismatched unit labels are not implicitly converted. tasks.bounds_and_open_scope: No PDF table extraction, raster chart interpretation, render verification or holistic visual-quality judgment. Data fidelity can pass while presentation warnings remain; neither proves good pedagogy.

tasks.implemented_behavior: Candidate-bound weighted proposition/citation checking against exact captured authored source text.
tasks.bounded_contract:
Reference payload: sources {id,text_sha256,locator}, claims {id,weight,proposition,supports}. Candidate: claims {id,proposition,citations}. A typed proposition has subject,predicate,object; IDs and scalar types are strict.
Actual source_artifacts text must exactly match the trusted source roster and UTF-8 hashes. Spans use Python/Unicode codepoint indices, not byte offsets or grapheme clusters. Reference spans have expected span SHA256. Candidate citations must all match annotated supports; at least one annotated support is required per present claim.
Each trusted claim earns all or zero declared weight; missing, changed, uncited or unannotated claims fail. Duplicate citations/unknown claims or sources are blocked rather than discarded. Grounding is measured from artifacts, not a candidate-owned PASS assertion.
tasks.bounds_and_open_scope: Exact span binding does not establish entailment, truth or licensing. Proposition-to-source support is curated, not NLP-inferred. Original authored text is bundled only in fixture artifacts. Independent source review and native PDF/text span adaptation remain open.

tasks.implemented_behavior: Weighted trusted concept facets and relation fidelity without keyword-overlap grading.
tasks.bounded_contract:
Reference concepts have id,positive weight,nonempty typed facets; reference relations have id,weight,from,predicate,to. Candidate concepts omit weight; relations omit weight.
A concept earns matched required facets/number required facets times its weight. Missing/wrong facets lose credit. Unexpected facets are defects even if required facet recall is complete. Missing concepts stay in denominator; unknown IDs and duplicates rejected.
Each relation is all-or-zero: exact directed triple and both endpoints actually supplied/taught. Reference concept/relation unit-ID collisions rejected. Input list order does not change unit scoring.
tasks.bounds_and_open_scope: No free-text paraphrase understanding, arbitrary semantic equivalence, learner comprehension or human-rater agreement measured. Trusted graph annotation quality needs independent review.

tasks.implemented_behavior: Prerequisite transitive closure and teach-before-use under a trusted acyclic graph.
tasks.bounded_contract:
Reference: nodes, directed weighted prerequisite/dependent edges, target IDs and trusted known_prior IDs. Candidate: unique teaching_order only.
Validate the complete DAG; required nodes are backward closure of targets, stopping at trusted known_prior. Each required node has weight1; each edge into required learning nodes has its declared positive weight. Nodes must occur, and prerequisites must appear earlier unless independently marked known_prior.
All known targets yield blocked NO_UNMASTERED_TARGET_IN_PROFILE rather than a vacuous 100 percent. Missing items remain denominator terms. Candidate cannot insert its own prior-knowledge flags.
tasks.bounds_and_open_scope: No assessment of actual learner mastery, text/scene alignment, optimal instructional sequence or universal prerequisite validity. Prior knowledge and graph must come from trusted upstream evidence.

tasks.implemented_behavior: Finite forward Horn-rule proof checking with trusted facts and no invented premises.
tasks.bounded_contract:
Reference: facts {id,atom}, rules {id,antecedents,consequent}, weighted goals {id,atom,weight}. Candidate steps: id,rule_id,premises,conclusion.
Only trusted facts or valid preceding steps can support premises. Premise atoms must equal the complete antecedent set. Invalid/forward/circular steps do not enter the proven set; step IDs cannot shadow fact IDs. Rule conclusion must match exactly.
Goals earn all-or-zero weight when available from trusted/valid proof. Any invalid extra step yields FAIL even if all requested goals earn credit. Score and outcome must be consumed together.
tasks.bounds_and_open_scope: This is a bounded formal proof calculus, not validation of arbitrary natural-language reasoning, induction, analogy, uncertainty, temporal or spatial reasoning. Such adapters require additional governed work.

tasks.implemented_behavior: Unit-aware exact arithmetic, bounded polynomial identities and rational-expression domain preservation.
tasks.bounded_contract:
Reference checks: id,weight,kind,expected,absolute_tolerance,relative_tolerance. Candidate checks: id,value.
Quantity profile uses a fixed units whitelist (1,m,cm,mm,km,s,min,kg,g,N,kN,J,kJ,K,degC), canonical dimensions/scales/temperature offsets. Comparison tolerance is max(atol,rtol*abs(expected)) in canonical base units; rtol<=0.01; tolerance is trusted, never supplied by candidate.
Polynomial profile: exact constant-first coefficient arrays, at most9 entries, trailing zeros normalized. Algebra tolerance must be zero.
Rational-function profile: bounded numerator polynomial, denominator given as product of up to8 factors (x-root), up to16 explicit excluded values; all denominator roots must be excluded. Compare exact cross products and exact domain exclusion sets, so cancellation does not erase a domain hole. No eval or arbitrary expression parser.
tasks.bounds_and_open_scope: Not a general CAS, theorem prover or support for transcendental expressions, arbitrary units, differential equations or unrestricted multivariate algebra. This checks supplied structured work, not extracted equations or mental calculation.

tasks.implemented_behavior: Directed graph and intervention/counterfactual fidelity in declared acyclic linear structural causal models.
tasks.bounded_contract:
Reference model: each node has id,intercept,noise,parents {node,coefficient}. All nodes/edges unique, acyclic, bounded, with nonzero edge coefficients. Queries specify positive weight, interventions,target,inference_kind.
Solve in topological order. A do intervention replaces the intervened node equation, not its exogenous ancestors. Fixed noise is retained for explicitly labeled counterfactual_fixed_noise queries. Candidate edges and numeric query answers are checked independently against trusted model.
True edges contribute weight1; queries have declared weights. Missing/reversed edges lose credit; unsupported extra edges veto PASS. Association cannot be relabeled as intervention/counterfactual; correct numbers with wrong inference_kind fail.
tasks.bounds_and_open_scope: No empirical identification, causal discovery, proof of real-world causal validity, stochastic uncertainty estimation or universal counterfactual reasoning. Model assumptions and noise are supplied and require independent validation.
